originalIdentity.title: Multidimensional Assessment of Interoceptive Awareness, Version 2 (MAIA-2)

textNormalization: XML text content; leading item number removed; layout whitespace collapsed only; punctuation/case retained. No wording merged from PDF, body text, S1 or any Chinese version.
administrationOriginal: Below you will find a list of statements. Please indicate how often each statement applies to you generally in daily life. Circle one number on each line.
administrationOriginalCarrier: S1 Questionnaire and UCSF2018 PDF; independent guidance separate from Table2 item wording.
administrationZh: 下面列出一些陈述。请根据一般日常生活中的情况，指出每项陈述符合你的频率，每行选择一个数字：0表示“从不”，5表示“总是”；中间选项保留数字1、2、3、4。

items.original: When I am tense, I notice where the tension is located in my body.
items.zh: 紧张时，我会注意到身体哪个部位紧绷。

items.original: I notice when I am uncomfortable in my body.
items.zh: 身体不舒服时，我会注意到。

items.original: I notice where in my body I am comfortable.
items.zh: 我会注意到身体哪些部位感觉舒服。

items.original: I notice changes in my breathing, such as whether it slows down or speeds up.
items.zh: 我会注意到呼吸的变化，例如变慢或变快。

items.original: I ignore physical tension or discomfort until they become more severe.
items.zh: 我会忽略身体的紧绷或不适，直到它们变得更严重。

items.original: I distract myself from sensations of discomfort.
items.zh: 我会转移注意力，不去感觉身体的不适。

items.original: When I feel pain or discomfort, I try to power through it.
items.zh: 感到疼痛或不适时，我会试着硬撑过去。

items.original: I try to ignore pain
items.zh: 我会试着忽略疼痛

items.original: I push feelings of discomfort away by focusing on something
items.zh: 我会把注意力集中到某件事情上，来推开不舒服的感觉

items.original: When I feel unpleasant body sensations, I occupy myself with something else so I don’t have to feel them.
items.zh: 感到身体不舒服时，我会让自己忙于别的事情，这样就不用感觉到它们。

items.original: When I feel physical pain, I become upset.
items.zh: 感到身体疼痛时，我会心烦意乱。

items.original: I start to worry that something is wrong if I feel any discomfort.
items.zh: 只要感觉有任何不适，我就开始担心是不是出了什么问题。

items.original: I can notice an unpleasant body sensation without worrying about it.
items.zh: 我能注意到身体不舒服的感觉，而不为此担忧。

items.original: I can stay calm and not worry when I have feelings of discomfort or pain.
items.zh: 感到不适或疼痛时，我能保持平静而不担忧。

items.original: When I am in discomfort or pain I can’t get it out of my mind
items.zh: 感到不适或疼痛时，我无法把它从脑海中放下

items.original: I can pay attention to my breath without being distracted by things happening around me.
items.zh: 我能把注意力放在呼吸上，而不被周围发生的事情分心。

items.original: I can maintain awareness of my inner bodily sensations even when there is a lot going on around me.
items.zh: 即使周围有很多事情发生，我仍能觉察到身体内部的感觉。

items.original: When I am in conversation with someone, I can pay attention to my posture.
items.zh: 与人交谈时，我能留意自己的姿势。

items.original: I can return awareness to my body if I am distracted.
items.zh: 分心后，我能重新把觉察带回身体。

items.original: I can refocus my attention from thinking to sensing my body.
items.zh: 我能把注意力从思考重新转向感受身体。

items.original: I can maintain awareness of my whole body even when a part of me is in pain or discomfort.
items.zh: 即使身体某个部位疼痛或不适，我仍能觉察整个身体。

items.original: I am able to consciously focus on my body as a whole.
items.zh: 我能有意识地把身体作为一个整体来关注。

items.original: I notice how my body changes when I am angry.
items.zh: 生气时，我会注意到身体怎样变化。
items.dimensionLabel: 觉察身体与情绪的联系

items.original: When something is wrong in my life, I can feel it in my body.
items.zh: 生活中出了问题时，我能在身体里感觉到。
items.dimensionLabel: 觉察身体与情绪的联系

items.original: I notice that my body feels different after a peaceful experience.
items.zh: 经历平静之后，我会注意到身体的感觉有所不同。
items.dimensionLabel: 觉察身体与情绪的联系

items.original: I notice that my breathing becomes free and easy, when I feel comfortable.
items.zh: 感觉舒服时，我会注意到呼吸变得轻松自在。
items.dimensionLabel: 觉察身体与情绪的联系

items.original: I notice how my body changes when I feel happy / joyful.
items.zh: 感到高兴或喜悦时，我会注意到身体怎样变化。
items.dimensionLabel: 觉察身体与情绪的联系

items.original: When I feel overwhelmed, I can find a calm place inside.
items.zh: 感到难以应付时，我能在内心找到一处平静。

items.original: When I bring awareness to my body, I feel a sense of calm.
items.zh: 把觉察带到身体上时，我会感到平静。

items.original: I can use my breath to reduce tension.
items.zh: 我能通过呼吸减轻紧张。

items.original: When I am caught up in thoughts, I can calm my mind by focusing on my body/breathing.
items.zh: 陷入思绪时，我能通过关注身体或呼吸让心静下来。

items.original: I listen for information from my body about my emotional state.
items.zh: 我会倾听身体提供的信息，了解自己的情绪状态。

items.original: When I am upset, I take time to explore how my body feels.
items.zh: 心烦时，我会花时间探索身体的感觉。

items.original: I listen to my body to inform me about what to do.
items.zh: 我会倾听身体，以了解自己该怎样做。

items.original: I am at home in my body.
items.zh: 待在自己的身体里，我感到自在。

items.original: I feel my body is a safe place.
items.zh: 我感觉身体是一个安全的地方。

items.original: I trust my body sensations.
items.zh: 我信任身体的感觉。
